x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
numerator = 0
denominator = 1
min_diff = 1e18
for b in range(1, n + 1):
    a_lower_bound = b * x // y
    a_upper_bound = (b * x + y - 1) // y
    diff_lower = abs(a_lower_bound / b - x / y)
    diff_upper = abs(a_upper_bound / b - x / y)
    if diff_lower < min_diff and abs(diff_lower - min_diff) > 1e-15:
        min_diff = diff_lower
        numerator = a_lower_bound
        denominator = b
    if diff_upper < min_diff and abs(diff_upper - min_diff) > 1e-15:
        min_diff = diff_upper
        numerator = a_upper_bound
        denominator = b
print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
